preflight: Operator chooses date and checks weather/park notices.
Scout route and entrances; record actual walking distance/time/access barriers, do not guess.
Obtain venue/subject permissions; do not record minors without appropriate guardian permission.
No drone plan; no filming assumed exempt from permit rules.
Capture no private documents, phone/email, reservation codes or identifiable conversations.
Use owned/licensed audio; log rights and permitted website/YouTube/Shorts uses.
No risky walking camera movement near crossings; stop filming when obstructive.
Mark take/date/location/consent in private production log; do not commit personal release forms.
If location refuses access or a pop-up ends, skip; do not stage proof.
After shoot: archive originals securely, choose consented edits, strip metadata before public media upload.
